additional_info.subject: RE: ID0479145-DC/Si-D/SE-[Null] Request to Finalize Pending Pre‑Auth Transactions CRM:02681001468
additional_info.body:
Hi Priscilla
This information was provided from Etka when he created the ticket.
Please stop removing information in the description.
Kind regards Magnus
We are experiencing a problem with the card terminal there at Cheap Charge Alvesta, we have been in contact with Seitatech about it. The chargers that are currently in Alvesta were previously the Cheap Charge Skurup 5-8 chargers, we moved them to Alvesta. This is what Seitatech says:
"
terminal still has Cheap Charge Skurup parameters. Because terminal pre-auths are not finalised or removed yet.
pre-auth file: 0/251023000441_pre
pre-auth file: 0/251120000475_pre
pre-auth file: 0/251229000583_pre
These pre-auths need to finalize or cancel first, after that terminal can download new Alvesta parameters.
I can see that terminal works and transactions comes under Cheap Charge Skurup Asklidenväge
you should contact Siemens and ask them to finalize those 3 pre-auths from terminal.
